references.text: To follow the Lord and not turn away from him is a central theme in Deuteronomy.
The burnt offering is mentioned as one of the types of offerings placed on the altar.
Grain offering (minhah) as one of the lawful forms of sacrifice brought to the Lord.
Peace offering (shelamim) as one of the approved forms of sacrifice to the Lord.
The same context where the Israelites assure that they will not build an altar to rebel against the Lord.
Instructions on where burnt offerings are to be sacrificed, which is relevant to the discussion about building an altar.
Samuel warns the people not to turn away from the Lord.
God examines and knows the secrets of the heart – 'the Lord himself will require it'.
